In [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], the [[Khommite/Legends|Khommite]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Dorsk 82]] utilized a '''starship''' in an effort to rescue a number of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ando/Legends|Ando]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Along with his [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], [[Hhen]], Dorsk 82 tried to get thirty-eight droids off-planet ahead of a mob of [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] intent on destroying them to appease the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was destroyed on the order of a [[Unidentified Aqualish security officer|security officer]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] Hhen and destroying the droids on board.
